Reviewed raw-memory boundary: pointer/slice construction is confined to a locally validated allocation or mapped region whose length/alignment/lifetime invariants are checked by the surrounding safe wrapper.

Reviewed one-shot ownership handoff: InitializedAppData is a private non-Copy token created only after the StaticCell slot is exclusively claimed and every AppData field is initialized. Consuming the token is the sole safe path that converts its NonNull<AppData> into the long-lived mutable application root, so safe code cannot duplicate the mutable reference.

Reviewed static placement boundary: the private no-inline initializer operates only on properly aligned field pointers derived from the exclusively claimed StaticCell<MaybeUninit<AppData>> slot; each destination is written exactly once and is never read or dropped before full AppData initialization. The boundary exists to prevent Xtensa LTO from materializing aggregate constructor temporaries on the ProCpu stack.
